models: Graph parser with Hyperedge Replacement Grammar (HRG)

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Graph parser with Hyperedge Replacement Grammar (HRG)' as it's part of the methodology rather than a distinct model. Normalized model names and output descriptions.
No automatic metrics were used for NLG evaluation in this paper.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper.
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on graph parsing algorithms for natural language generation (specifically surface realization from semantic graphs) but does not evaluate the actual generated text. The evaluation is computational efficiency of the parsing algorithm (speed, memory usage, number of integrations) rather than quality of generated outputs. The paper mentions surface realization as an application but doesn't present NLG evaluation results.
